description: Update the entire build pipeline, home page, deploy script, .gitignore, and developer-spec docs to use the new sample_patients/ structure instead of marcus_bundle/. Add a patient selector to build_home.py so it can build views for any patient. This FEAT depends on FEAT-001 (needs sample_patients/ to exist with generated data).
steps: Step 1: Update build_home.py — _set_env() function. Change the path construction from os.path.join('marcus_bundle', qe_folder, ...) to os.path.join('sample_patients', patient_id, qe_folder, ...). Add a PATIENT_ID variable (read from env var PATIENT_ID or default to 'marcus_evans'). Add sys.argv parsing so `python build_home.py [patient_id]` works. The function signature becomes _set_env(patient_id, qe_folder, out_file, qe_name, title=''). Update all 5 _set_env() calls to pass patient_id. Update the index.html template: change the note div that says 'Each QE renders Marcus in its own look & feel...' to be generic or reference 'the selected patient'. Add a patient picker section to the home page that lists available patients from sample_patients/ directory (read subdirectories, load each patient's identity from their first CCD or from patient_profiles.json). The picker should default to marcus_evans and link to the same QE views but with a patient parameter.

Step 2: Update the index.html generation in build_home.py to show a patient list. Read patient_profiles.json to get the list of patients. For each patient, show name and key conditions. The home page should have a dropdown or card-based patient selector in the QE portals section. When a patient is selected, the QE links should still point to the same *Emulator.html files (since those are built for the selected patient). The simplest approach: build_home.py builds for one patient at a time (the default or the one passed as argument). The home page shows which patient is currently loaded. Add a note like 'Currently viewing: Marcus Evans (Patient 1 of 10). Run `python build_home.py <patient_id>` to switch.'

Step 3: Verify the build scripts (build_smart.py, build_chart.py, build_bronx.py, build_healtheconn.py) do NOT need changes — they already read from env vars (CHART_CCD_DIR, CHART_ORU_HL7, CHART_TRN_DIR, CHART_OUT, CHART_QE). The _set_env() change in build_home.py is the only place that constructs the paths. Confirm by reading each script's env-var usage and verifying it matches. If any script has hardcoded 'marcus_bundle' references (beyond comments), update those too.

Step 4: Update .gitignore. Replace the marcus_bundle/ exclusion lines with sample_patients/ equivalents. Change: 'marcus_bundle/*/ccda/' to 'sample_patients/*/ccda/' — wait, the structure changed to sample_patients/{patient_id}/{qe}/... so the pattern needs to be 'sample_patients/*/*/ccda/', 'sample_patients/*/*/oru-hl7/', 'sample_patients/*/*/trn/', 'sample_patients/*/mpi/'. Also update the comment from 'build_marcus_bundle.py' to 'generate_patients.py'. Keep the !ccds/ exception.

Step 5: Update deploy_amplify.ps1. The file list in Copy-Item should stay the same (index.html + 5 *Emulator.html + JS files). No path changes needed since the deploy copies output HTML, not source data. But update the comment if it references marcus_bundle.

Step 6: Update README.md. Replace references to build_marcus_bundle.py with generate_patients.py. Replace marcus_bundle/ with sample_patients/. Update the file tree section. Update the build instructions to show: `python generate_patients.py` then `python build_home.py`.

Step 7: Update developer-spec docs. In developer-spec/00-start-here.md: update references to Marcus being the only patient — note that 10 synthetic patients exist, Marcus is #1. In developer-spec/04-pdr-data-model.md: update fixture references if needed (the fixtures themselves are static JSON snapshots and may be left as-is since they represent the data model, not the generation). In developer-spec/README.md: update the demo description from 'one synthetic patient' to '10 synthetic patients, led by Marcus Evans'. Update docs/marcus-multi-qe-plan.md and docs/plan-portal40-migration.md: replace marcus_bundle references with sample_patients/.

Step 8: Run `python generate_patients.py` then `python build_home.py` and verify: (a) build_home.py exits 0, (b) all 6 HTML files are produced (index.html + 5 *Emulator.html), (c) the HTML files contain Marcus Evans data (default patient), (d) run `python build_home.py cardiac_patient` (or patient #2's id) and verify it produces HTML with a different patient's data.
acceptance_criteria: python build_home.py runs without errors after generate_patients.py has been run, producing index.html + 5 *Emulator.html
build_home.py accepts an optional patient_id argument, defaulting to marcus_evans
The generated HTML pages render the same clinical sections as before (conditions, labs, meds, vitals, encounters, immunizations, procedures)
.gitignore excludes sample_patients/ generated data instead of marcus_bundle/
deploy_amplify.ps1 works without changes to its file list (or is updated if needed)
README.md and developer-spec docs reference the new structure and generate_patients.py
No remaining references to marcus_bundle/ in any .py, .ps1, or tracked .md file (except historical context in docs)
verification: python generate_patients.py && python build_home.py — exits 0, prints file list
python -c "import os; assert os.path.exists('index.html'); assert os.path.exists('HixnyEmulator.html'); assert os.path.exists('BronxEmulator.html'); print('All HTML files present')"
python -c "f=open('HixnyEmulator.html').read(); assert 'Marcus' in f and 'Evans' in f; print('Marcus data in Hixny view')"
grep -r 'marcus_bundle' *.py *.ps1 README.md developer-spec/*.md — should return no hits (or only historical/contextual references in docs/)
findings: build_home.py now reads patient_profiles.json and accepts patient_id as sys.argv[1] or PATIENT_ID env var, defaulting to marcus_evans. _set_env() paths changed from marcus_bundle/{qe} to sample_patients/{patient_id}/{qe}. All 6 HTML files produced for marcus_evans (default) and verified for gloria_washington (patient #2). Index.html shows 'Currently viewing: Marcus Evans (Patient 1 of 10)'. build_smart.py comment updated. .gitignore updated from marcus_bundle/ to sample_patients/*/*/ patterns. deploy_amplify.ps1 updated with pre-requisite comment. README.md, developer-spec/00-start-here.md, developer-spec/README.md, docs/marcus-multi-qe-plan.md, docs/plan-portal40-migration.md all updated to reference generate_patients.py and sample_patients/. No remaining marcus_bundle references in active .py/.ps1/.md files (only in old build_marcus_bundle.py and a comment in generate_patients.py). Pre-existing SyntaxWarning about \w in JS regex strings causes PowerShell exit code 1 — not from these changes.
